### Three Areas We Can Trust God With Today
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-december-19-2024.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 14:22-23
Points:
- God invites believers into unhurried spiritual rhythms of abiding, dwelling, and resting in His presence.
- Setting aside a harvest portion year by year guards against rushing past God's provision.
- Gathering at the dwelling place of God protects our souls from turning to worldly comfort idols.
- The tithe was commanded not for God's physical sustenance, but to teach reverence and foster heartfelt communion.
- Surrendering a portion of what we receive back to God remains a continual act of trust and worship.

### Putting God First in Every Area
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-september-7-2026.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 14:23
Points:
- The fundamental purpose of tithing is learning to give God first place in our daily lives.
- God does not need our finances, but He desires what money represents: our heart and our trust.
- Giving the tithe directly to God is an act of personal worship rather than general charitable relief.
- Intentionally setting aside giving from the start of our income demonstrates that God is our top priority.
- Believers who trust God with their finances will discover His faithfulness to supply their needs.
